From: Kevin Grigg <KGrigg@pistons.com> 
Sent: Friday, January 31, 2020 12:39 PM
To: Beard, Rod <RBeard@detroitnews.com>; Ellis, Vince <vellis@freepress.com>; James Edwards III <jedwards@theathletic.com>; Ansar Khan <AKHAN1@mlive.com>; lwilliams@mlive.com; Russ, James <JRuss@detroitnews.com>; Crawford, Kirkland <kcrawford@freepress.com>; gkann144@foxtv.com; Kamberovski, Luan <lkamberovski@wdiv.com>; mfoss@wxyz.com
Subject: FW: All-Star Credential Application - Deadline Monday

From: Fischel, Mark <MFischel@nba.com> 
Sent: Friday, January 31, 2020 12:26 PM
To: NBA Team PR <NBA_Team_PR@nba.com>
Subject: All-Star Credential Application - Deadline Monday
Now that the Reserves and Rising Stars have been announced, please re-send the All-Star Credential Advisory to your media distribution lists today. Do note that the deadline to apply is this Monday.
Lastly, if your PR staff attending All-Star has changed, please let me know.
Let me know if you have any questions, and thank you for your assistance.

Mark Fischel
League Credentialist
Phone: +1 (212) 407-8047
Mobile: +1 (201) 275-8952
Fax: 646-264-4366
